$comment: The native review round of the app copy (docs/review/app-copy.md), 29 Sep 2026. Reviewer: docs/review/app-copy-gemini.md (its exact Sinhala), with the owner's accept / adjust / reject rulings. No API calls. scripts/extract-copy.ts reads this file for each string's status in docs/review/app-copy.md.

statuses.accepted: the reviewer's correction, applied as given
statuses.adjusted: the reviewer's correction, adjusted by the owner (loanwords with a natural Sinhala equivalent replaced)
statuses.kept: the reviewer's correction rejected by the owner; the string stays
statuses.consistency: changed only by the consistency pass (ආයෙ → ආයෙත්)
statuses.added: a string the sheet was missing, added from the review
statuses.reviewed: in the reviewed table with no correction
statuses.fromScript: verbatim in the authored lesson script

common.sessionNth.reviewerWhy: Spoken Sinhala uses "වෙනි" for ordinal numbers, "වන" is strictly for writing.
